mechanism: FastMul.fastLog2 checks x >>> 47 == 1, then x >>> 46 == 1, otherwise reuses the six-step binary-search helper. No rounding, scalar fallback, add or tensor-loop change.
expected_domain: The product of two normal 24-bit significands lies in [2^46,2^48), so its highest set bit is 46 or 47. Guarded equivalence is intended for every UInt64, including zero and larger words.
equivalence_reason: The reference log2_shift lemma gives log2(x)=k+log2(x>>>k). Each guard makes the shifted value one; otherwise the original fallback theorem applies. Existing roundP_eq, impl_eq, mul_spec and tensor proofs are reused.
